limitation: Full-data fixed-20-epoch development experiment. Default seed 2026 only; additional seeds require a separate explicit launch. Two-qubit cells also change encoding, parameter count and readout. ADE/FDE minima at different epochs are separate checkpoints, never a combined model score.
individual_metric_minima_note: Each row retains the full ADE/FDE/J tuple from its own epoch; no synthetic mixed-epoch score. Only best-J and latest weights are retained by the shared trainer.

final_epoch_contrasts.interpretation: Metric differences; negative indicates lower error for the positive-sign cell. Best-epoch contrasts may compare different epochs.

best_J_epoch_contrasts.interpretation: Metric differences; negative indicates lower error for the positive-sign cell. Best-epoch contrasts may compare different epochs.
